question: Should per-agent dashboard tab/widget grouping be accepted as a Wave 2 modular-dashboard feature after the base workspaces view lands, or should it be folded into the broader multi-agent orchestration/topology work?
rationale: Current main has only the generic plugin-tab seam, while the requested behavior depends on unmerged dashboard infrastructure and overlaps active multi-agent UI product discussions.

options.title: Keep As Dashboard Follow-Up
options.body: Track this issue as the dashboard-specific follow-up for grouping accepted workspace content by agent provenance after the base dashboard workspaces surface is decided.

options.title: Fold Into Multi-Agent Topology
options.body: Redirect the need into the broader Control UI multi-agent topology/orchestration work if maintainers want relationship debugging outside the dashboard workspace model.

options.title: Defer Until Wave 1 Resolves
options.body: Leave this unscheduled until the base dashboard PR series is merged, narrowed, or rejected, then revisit the grouping layer against the accepted shape.

recommendation.title: Keep As Dashboard Follow-Up
recommendation.body: Track this issue as the dashboard-specific follow-up for grouping accepted workspace content by agent provenance after the base dashboard workspaces surface is decided.
